description: Source code for the Inspector class in the breakpad crash generation system, responsible for inspecting processes, handling mach ports, and generating minidumps on macOS.

classes.name: Inspector
classes.description: Class responsible for inspecting crashed processes, managing mach ports, and generating crash minidumps on macOS.

methods.name: Inspect
methods.description: Main method to perform inspection of a process given a receive port name.

methods.name: ResetBootstrapPort
methods.description: Resets the bootstrap port for communication.

methods.name: ServiceCheckIn
methods.description: Checks in the service with the bootstrap server.

methods.name: ServiceCheckOut
methods.description: Cleans up and unregisters the service.

methods.name: ReadMessages
methods.description: Reads mach messages from the crashed process to gather crash info.

methods.name: InspectTask
methods.description: Suspends the task, generates a minidump, and resumes the task.

methods.name: SendAcknowledgement
methods.description: Sends an acknowledgement message to the crashed process after inspection.
